power net V5 runs at 0.15mm — the same copper as a signal. The current maths may pass on this board, but power at signal width is the wrong habit; the profile's power floor is 0.5mm (warn_power_trace_mm — an EE moves the line there)

the board declares autorouterEffortLevel="10x", which is the hardest routing pass this pipeline will run, so no retry was attempted. 2 routing-class finding(s) survived it — the remaining lever is the placement, not the router.

this pair kept the autorouter's copper: two layers: no corridor wide enough for the pair exists between the two ends (needs 0.99mm of clear copper plus clearance, on any of top, bottom); one layer: no corridor wide enough for the pair exists between the two ends (needs 0.57mm of clear copper plus clearance, on any of top)

V5: 56 of 113 segments widened, 38% of the run now at the 0.5mm power floor. Narrowest point 0.15mm -> 0.15mm, set by pcb_via_130.pad
J1's keep-out extends 0.481mm past the board outline — intended for an edge-mounted part, confirm it on JLCPCB's placement preview
U3 sits exactly on the 0.4mm pitch floor — legal, with no margin for a footprint revision

9 part(s) are in package families whose zero-rotation convention differs between EDA output and JLCPCB's library: J1, LED1, LED2, LED3, LED4, U1, U2, U4, Y1. Check pin-1 on each in the placement preview before paying — that screen is the only place this is catchable

USB_DP/USB_DM run within 0.60mm of each other (4x the 0.15mm trace) for only 24% of the run — a differential pair should travel together (widest gap 4.61mm). The pipeline's pair pass (circuitpy.diffpair) either could not route this pair or was switched off; its report says which. Review the pair before ordering

USB_DP_CONN/USB_DM_CONN run within 0.60mm of each other (4x the 0.15mm trace) for only 36% of the run — a differential pair should travel together (widest gap 3.10mm). The pipeline's pair pass (circuitpy.diffpair) either could not route this pair or was switched off; its report says which. Review the pair before ordering

19% of USB_DP's run has ground copper on the opposite layer within 0.5mm. A differential pair needs a continuous return path under it or its impedance is undefined and its return current goes wherever it can. Pour ground on the free layer under the pair
U2's nearest decoupling capacitor to pin VIN is 9.7mm away; the loop inductance is what does the work, so keep it inside 5mm (1 pin(s) are further)
U3's nearest decoupling capacitor to pin IOVDD3 is 6.1mm away; the loop inductance is what does the work, so keep it inside 5mm (2 pin(s) are further)
2 signal(s) leave the board through J1 with no ESD clamp on them (J1.A5, J1.B5). A finger on a connector is several kilovolts
U2 dissipates 0.23W at 134mA and sits about 59 degC junction, 66 degC inside the limit
